analysis.missing_quality: keep missing and reasons; report score availability and complete status; conditional quality means never replace missing by zero
analysis.aggregation: each real image first; primary building-equal average across supported buildings plus image-equal/median and all building effects; paired image support for each fixed contrast; no resampled-team pseudo-replication
analysis.uncertainty: building-resampling descriptive interval and individual building effects; no post-selection p-value success gate
analysis.structure: native reference node/direct adjacency diagnostics plus new collinearity-insensitive wall coverage and true-turn location recall; no semantic necessary-structure ground truth
analysis.block_primary: m>=2; single-person m1 supplementary; same actual core, same actual m for A/B and A/C
analysis.controls: total classification effect first; then exact new/old matched events; same incoming historical Q difference<=3 subset; controls q_beta+own-condition Q where supported; compare common new-source workers; never fit category counts jointly with a saturated worker indicator model
analysis.individual_sensitivity: leave-one-worker-out recomputation of summaries from sampled teams when supported; report retained images and finite-member capacity
analysis.case_selection: after all frozen-rule results: clear positive, conditional complement, stable wrong, quality-matched structural difference, strongest counterexamples; case selection descriptive, not validation denominator
